original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP_NV_NIC_NS1 through NSN sensors are correctly mapped to the owner-defined NS network components and ports and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved thermal specification.
original_method: Define the NS role/component namespace, enumerate the complete NS component/port population and immutable BMC raw/UI identities, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized component identity, health, link state, traffic counters and passive airflow context, and compare each result to the owner rules.
manual_activity: The owner defines NS, supplies component/port/sensor mapping and thermal limits; an operator verifies raw/UI/component identity and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and owner-defined NS1..NSN component/port inventory
Definition of NS plus physical component/port to PCIe/BDF/MAC and SDR/Redfish/UI sensor mapping
Temperature unit/scale/warning/critical threshold and expected range specification
Approved BMC-versus-component temperature relationship plus read-only health/link/traffic/airflow context
UI refresh/rounding/lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never generate unapproved traffic or change link speed, component power, fan, threshold or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to immutable NS component/port identity and synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on component health/link/thermal alarm, stale/impossible value, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not infer NS meaning or retry after changing traffic
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify all owner-defined NS components, ports and sensor mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with read-only context
Assist with synchronized WebUI and approved same-component telemetry capture/normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, mapping or raw/UI/component/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no network load/policy mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define NS and supply authoritative topology, thermal limits and correlation rules
Review component identity, sensor location, link/load timing and raw/UI discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose a BMC record, but a literal TEMP_NV_NIC_NS1~N name and head-limited fallback cannot define NS, prove all components/ports, complete thresholds, UI presentation or same-component context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner definition, securely enumerate complete BMC sensors and network-component inventory, join each NS component/port to immutable identities, capture full read-only metadata/context, then correlate WebUI and approved component telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_NV_NIC_NS1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED NS NETWORK-COMPONENT TEMPERATURE VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-component matrix of NS designation/meaning, physical and PCIe/BDF/MAC/port identity, BMC sensor value/threshold and UI display, plus health/link/traffic/airflow and approved telemetry with timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit NS semantics and immutable component mapping while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and load generation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One sensor value cannot define or cover NS1..NSN. Every owner-defined NS component and sensor must be reconciled independently of EW and HIB domains.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NS is not self-defining; it may identify a fabric role, board site or subsystem. Applying generic NIC assumptions before the hardware map is unsafe.

project_override_considerations: If NS labels are logical roles that can move between adapters, the current role-to-physical identity map must be captured with evidence; EW or other component temperatures cannot fill missing NS coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/NS definition/topology/thermal spec revision
Per-NS component/port to physical/PCIe/BDF/MAC and raw/UI sensor identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI and approved component telemetry with source/location/lag comparison
Per-component discrepancies, no-load/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently request NS-labeled network temperature validation. Undefined platform-specific NS semantics require package input but do not contradict the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: NS definition/topology, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/component-context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Prevents an undefined NS label from being treated as generic NIC identity and requires a complete owner-defined component map before evaluation.
independent_technical_reasoning: NS is a platform-local label and cannot safely be expanded from intuition. It may refer to north-south networking, a board site or another subsystem, each with different topology and thermal context. The review therefore retains the original label but requires the owner map to bind it to physical and software identities. Only then can link/load context and any component telemetry be interpreted without conflating it with the EW group.
